slots.node01.text: AI has cut the time and cost of complex modernization by changing how teams analyze, design, build and test.
slots.node04.items.item01.text: Months of discovery compress to weeks.
slots.node04.items.item02.text: Teams modernize and add value in one program.
slots.node04.items.item03.text: Dependencies surface early, not at cutover.
slots.node05.text: If modernizing cost one-tenth of what you expect, what would you unlock first?
slots.title: The script has [[flipped]] on legacy systems: what once looked too slow, too costly and too risky to change is now the fastest way to fund growth, cut risk and free the teams who run the business every day.
